fragments.text: Their meal-offering and their drink offering shall be as has been said, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram and one tenth for each lamb, wine according to its drink-offering

and two he-goats in order to atone and the two regular offerings according to their rule. Besides the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering and its meal-offering and the drink offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.

variants.printed: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כַּמְדֻבָּר שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָיִל וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ וְיַיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ
